replies.author: Awarrior
replies.body:
Use this in your presets box for a void world

- World Edit, ASync World Edit, Voxel Sniper, Essentials.... etc

replies.body: I did it but there was no block to place anything on though
replies.body_tagged: I did it but there was no block to place anything on though

replies.author: lulle265
replies.body:
Do /setblock ~ ~ ~ stone
or /setblock ~ ~ ~ 1

and there will be a stone block at where you are.
